brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 例子是谁，交给已知去定。
hint.en: Who the example is, leave to a given.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>写成规则是 ⟦?P(?t)⟧ ⟹ ∃x. ?P(x)。?t 是代表一样东西的元变量：倒着用时，例子无法从目标读出，?t 就留着。<level-ref to="q-exI"></level-ref>里，有几句「存在」时要在元件上选得出哪一句；倒着用规则，目标自己就说明了。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> as a rule is ⟦?P(?t)⟧ ⟹ ∃x. ?P(x). ?t is a metavariable for a thing: used backwards, the example cannot be read off the goal, so ?t is left open. In <level-ref to="q-exI"></level-ref>, with several “there is” sentences, you chose on the part which to conclude; with a rule used backwards, the goal says so itself.
